title: domain.charge_filter_code
description: Generated code of a charge filter (BE-DM-56, BE-DM-57). canonical = keys sorted, each rendered `key:` + its values sorted and joined with `+`, joined with `|`. base_code = slug(canonical) truncated to 200 characters + `_` + first 8 hex digits of SHA-256(canonical as UTF-8). slug: normalise to NFC, transliterate to ASCII with the fixed table of BE-DM-59 (U+00C0-U+017E except U+00F7, plus U+01EA-U+01ED and U+1E9E; every other non-ASCII character becomes `?`), replace every run of characters other than ASCII letters, digits, `-` and `_` by `_`, collapse repeated `_`, drop a leading and a trailing `_`, lower-case. code = base_code if not taken, else base_code + `_2`, `_3`, ... (first free).

taken.description: Codes already used by filters of the same charge.
